ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Learning how to design student assessments In this course, students will learn how to design quality online assessments that are reliable and robust, while also interesting and relevant. They will meet with faculty on a weekly basis to go over assessment design principles, and will get continuous feedback for improvement. The course is restricted, requiring instructor approval (override).
